speeches.Japanese:
あれを見な！
あの艦隊こそ、アタシらの縄張りを
荒らしている
FOだ！
speeches.English:
Look over there! That's FO,
 the fleet that's been muscling 
 in on our territory!

speeches.Japanese: オオーッ！
speeches.English: Aye!!

speeches.Japanese:
総員戦闘配備！
スネーク、指揮を執って！
speeches.English:
All hands to battle stations!
 Snake, take command!

speeches.Japanese: おうよ
speeches.English: Aye!

speeches.Japanese:
エンジェル！
船を敵の右後方へ！
speeches.English:
Angel! Bring us around behind
 their right flank!

speeches.Japanese:
おっしゃっっっ！
がってん承知だぜい！！！
speeches.English: You got it!!!

speeches.Japanese:
ダンディー！　
砲撃の準備は？
speeches.English: Dandy! Guns ready?

speeches.Japanese: 整っております
speeches.English: Everything is ready.

speeches.Japanese:
…ふふっ、ゾクゾクするわ
いいかい、野郎どもっ！！！
speeches.English:
Heh, what a thrill.
 Listen up, boys!!!

speeches.Japanese:
今こそアタシと
FO、どちらが
この海を支配するにふさわしいか
決めてやろうじゃないか！
speeches.English:
Let's settle who's fit to rule 
 these waters: me or FO!

speeches.Japanese: オオーッ！！！
speeches.English: Aye!!!

speeches.Japanese: お…女海賊！？
speeches.English: A... a woman pirate?!

speeches.Japanese:
あんな海賊がいたなんて
初めて知ったよ
speeches.English:
I never knew there was a pirate
 like her.

speeches.Japanese: どのみち戦うしかねえよな
speeches.English: We have to fight.

speeches.Japanese:
負けるわけにはいかないよ！
みんな！　戦闘準備に入って！
speeches.English:
We can't afford to lose! Everyone, 
 prepare for battle!

SC0 B26.summary: Aziza’s crew turns on her after a defeat, blaming the losses and her pursuit of the fleet that has her father’s sword. Al intervenes. The confrontation leads to a settlement and Aziza explains what the sword means to her.

speeches.Japanese:
くっ、また負けたか…
だが、今度こそ………はっ！
speeches.English:
Damn, lost again...
 But next time... Huh?!

speeches.Japanese:
悪いが
あんたにゃ『今度』はねえんだ
speeches.English: Sorry, but there is no next time.

speeches.Japanese: くっくっくっ
speeches.English: Heh heh heh.

speeches.Japanese: なんだって！？　もう一度言ってみな！
speeches.English: What?! Say that again!

speeches.Japanese: ああ？　聞こえなかったか？
speeches.English: Huh? Didn't hear me?

speeches.Japanese:
あんたの言うことを聞くヤツなんざ
ここにゃ、誰もいねえってことよ！
speeches.English: Nobody here listens to you anymore!

speeches.Japanese:
…ちきしょう！
てめえら、裏切ったね！！
speeches.English: Damn you! Traitors!!

speeches.Japanese:
おい、FI！
あっちでなんか起こってるぜ！
speeches.English:
Hey, FI! Something's happening 
 over there!

speeches.Japanese: 例の女海賊が囲まれてるみたい…
speeches.English:
Looks like they've surrounded
 that pirate captain...

speeches.Japanese:
仲間割れかあ？
おい、近くまで行ってみようぜ
speeches.English: A mutiny? Let's get closer.

speeches.Japanese:
ここんとこ、負け続けでちっとも金が
増えやしねえ。あんたには、その責任を
とってもらわねえと
speeches.English:
We've done nothing but lose lately,
 and we haven't made a thing. Time
 you paid for that.

speeches.Japanese: 責任だと…
speeches.English: Paid...?

speeches.Japanese:
だいたい
なぜFOを
追いかけ回すんですかい？
speeches.English: Why do we keep chasing FO?

speeches.Japanese:
へっ、みんなに言えない
理由があるんだろ？！
speeches.English:
Heh. Got a reason you can't tell 
 the rest of us, don't you?!

speeches.Japanese:
あんたの魂胆は
FOから
『血塗られたシャムシール』を
取り戻したいだけなんだ
親父の形見だもんな！
speeches.English:
All you want is to get 
 the Bloodstained Shamshir back 
 from FO. It's your dead
 father's keepsake!

speeches.Japanese: それは…そんなつもりじゃ…
speeches.English: That's... It wasn't like that...

speeches.Japanese:
最近のあんたは、なってなかったぜ
金も稼げねえ頭についていく物好きは
いねえよ。覚悟しな！
speeches.English:
You've lost your touch. Nobody 
 wants a boss who can't make money. 
 Say your prayers!

speeches.Japanese:
聞いたか！
FI！
あの女、このままじゃ殺されるぜ！
speeches.English: Hear that, FI? They'll kill her!

speeches.Japanese: 俺が行く
speeches.English: I'll go.

speeches.Japanese: あ、アル…
speeches.English: A-Al...

speeches.Japanese:
なんだあ？
よそ者は引っ込んでな！
speeches.English: What do you want? Stay out of this!

speeches.Japanese: …下っ端が図に乗るな
speeches.English: ...Know your place.

speeches.Japanese:
てめえにゃ関係ねえ！
…この際だ、アズィーザもこいつも
まとめて片付けろ！
speeches.English:
None of your business! 
 ...Might as well finish him off
 with Aziza!

speeches.Japanese: アル殿、助太刀いたす
speeches.English: Al, I shall fight at your side.

speeches.Japanese:
あたしもやる！
数を頼むしかない男なんて、最低よ！
speeches.English:
Me too! Men who rely on numbers
 are the worst!

speeches.Japanese: 俺を忘れちゃ困るぜ！
speeches.English: Don't forget me!

speeches.Japanese:
…海賊ども！
さあ来い、やってやる！
speeches.English: ...Pirates! Come on, all of you!

speeches.Japanese:
どうして…？　なんで、アタシのために
戦ってるんだよ…
さっきまで敵だったのに…
speeches.English:
Why...? Why fight for me?
 We were enemies moments ago...

speeches.Japanese: く、くそっ、これじゃ分が悪いぜ！
speeches.English: D-damn it! The odds are against us!

speeches.Japanese: 待って！
speeches.English: Wait!

speeches.Japanese: FI・FA…
speeches.English: FI FA...

speeches.Japanese: …あんたもこの女に用があるのか？
speeches.English: You got business with her, too?

speeches.Japanese:
そうです
でも、話し合いで解決しましょう
speeches.English: Yes. Let's settle this by talking.

speeches.Japanese:
FI！
そんなの通用する相手じゃねえぞ！
speeches.English: FI! They won't listen to reason!

speeches.Japanese:
大丈夫だよ、クラウ
彼らが僕らに勝てると思う？
speeches.English: Relax, Clau. Think they can beat us?

speeches.Japanese: んなわけねえだろ
speeches.English: No chance.

speeches.Japanese:
じゃ大丈夫だよ
他の選択肢はないんだもん
speeches.English:
Then it'll be fine. They don't 
 have another choice.

speeches.Japanese:
ちくしょう…
話ぐらいは聞いてやらあ
speeches.English: Damn... All right, we'll listen.

speeches.Japanese:
あなたたちは、これ以上は
アズィーザさんと
一緒に船に乗りたくないんですね？
speeches.English:
You no longer want Aziza 
 as your captain, correct?

speeches.Japanese:
この女についていこうなんて奴は
この船にはいねえな
speeches.English: Nobody aboard wants to follow her.

speeches.Japanese: だったら…
speeches.English: Then...

speeches.Japanese:
お、おい、FI！
ま、まさか…このチンピラを
雇う気かよ！？
speeches.English:
H-hey, FI! Y-you aren't
 thinking of hiring 
 these thugs, are you?!

speeches.Japanese:
やだなあ、クラウ
僕らと一緒に来るのは
アズィーザさんのほうだよ
speeches.English: Come on, Clau. Aziza is joining us.

speeches.Japanese:
…そりゃ構わねえが
その女にはひでえ目に遭わされたんだ
迷惑料をもらわなくっちゃな
speeches.English:
...Fine by me. But she's put us
 through hell. We deserve something 
 for our trouble.

speeches.Japanese: 金を取るだと！？
speeches.English: You want money?!

speeches.Japanese: …いくら必要なんですか？
speeches.English: ...How much do you need?

speeches.Japanese: 金１００００００で手を打とう
speeches.English: Let's call it 1,000,000 gold.

speeches.Japanese:
これで文句はないですね
じゃ、アズィーザさん、こっちに
speeches.English:
That settles it, then. Come over 
 here, Aziza.

speeches.Japanese: でも…
speeches.English: But...

speeches.Japanese: もう用はねえな。あばよ！
speeches.English: We're done here. So long!

speeches.Japanese:
まさか、仲間に裏切られるとは
アタシも落ちたもんだよ…
それより、どうしてアタシを
助けたんだい？
speeches.English:
Betrayed by my own crew... How 
 far I've fallen. But why 
 did you save me?

speeches.Japanese: あの状況じゃあな…
speeches.English: Had no choice...

speeches.Japanese: 助けないわけにゃいかないだろ
speeches.English: We couldn't leave you.

speeches.Japanese:
それに、バスラの酒場で僕たちを
逃がしてくれたし。…気になって
たんだけど、なぜ海賊になったのか
聞いていいかな？
speeches.English:
Besides, you let us escape 
 at the tavern in Basra. I've 
 been wondering... Do you mind
 if I ask why you became a pirate?

speeches.Japanese:
…父さんが海賊だったのさ
アタシは海賊の娘
speeches.English:
...My father was a pirate. 
 I'm a pirate's daughter.

speeches.Japanese:
さっきの海賊どもは、みんな父さんの
手下。子供のころから、見よう見まねで
剣術を覚え、海賊稼業を学んだんだ
speeches.English:
Those men all served under 
 my father. I grew up watching
 them, copying their swordplay
 and learning the pirate trade.

speeches.Japanese: お父さんは…？
speeches.English: Your father?

speeches.Japanese:
事故で死んだよ。例の剣は父さんが
持っていたんだ。父さんと一緒に
消えてしまったけど…
speeches.English:
He died in an accident. That sword 
 was his, and vanished with him...

speeches.Japanese:
その剣が
『血塗られたシャムシール』…
speeches.English: The Bloodstained Shamshir...

speeches.Japanese:
僕に『いい剣を持ってる』って
言ったのはそのことだったんだね
speeches.English: So that's why you praised my sword.

speeches.Japanese:
アタシは父さんのような偉大な海賊に
なりたかった
父さんのことはなんでもまねした…
speeches.English:
I wanted to be a great pirate, like
 my father. I copied everything 
 he did...

speeches.Japanese:
だから、あんたたちがこの剣を
持ってるって知ったとき
どうしても手に入れたくなったんだ
そうすれば…
speeches.English:
So when I found out
 you had his sword, 
 I had to have it. I thought...

speeches.Japanese:
そうすれば、父さんに近づいた証に
なるって…
ふふっ、だけどね
speeches.English:
I thought it would prove 
 I was getting closer to being like 
 him. Heh... But then...

speeches.Japanese:
偉大な海賊になるより、ホントは
父さんの形見が欲しかっただけ
なんだって気が付いちゃってさ…
speeches.English:
I realized I wanted something
 to remember my father
 by more than I wanted
 to be a great pirate...

speeches.Japanese:
こんなんじゃ、見捨てられて当然ね
金にならない物を追いかけてたんだから
仲間が怒るのも無理ないか
speeches.English:
No wonder they abandoned me. 
 I was chasing something
 that wouldn't make them a penny. 
 I can't blame them for being angry.

speeches.Japanese: …まだ海賊に未練があるのか
speeches.English: ...Still want to be a pirate?

speeches.Japanese:
アタシが追っていたのは海賊じゃ
なくて、父さんだったんだもの
もう、足を洗うつもりさ
speeches.English:
I wasn't chasing a pirate's life.
 I was chasing my father. 
 I'm leaving that life behind.

speeches.Japanese:
じゃあ、僕たちと一緒に行こうよ
陸より、海で生きるほうが
向いてるでしょう？
speeches.English:
Then come with us! Life at sea 
 suits you better than
 life on land, doesn't it?

speeches.Japanese:
アタシがアンタらと…？
いいのかい…？
speeches.English: Me, with you...? Really?

speeches.Japanese: もちろん！
speeches.English: Sure!

speeches.Japanese:
ありがと…
目一杯、働かせてもらうよ
なんたって命の恩人だものね
speeches.English:
Thank you... I'll work as hard 
 as I can. I owe you my life, 
 after all.

speeches.Japanese:
それから、アタシのことは
アズィーザでいいわ
speeches.English: And just call me Aziza.

speeches.Japanese:
命の恩人だとよ
FI
speeches.English: She says you saved her life, FI.

speeches.Japanese:
もう、オーバーだなあ！
それを言うならお互い様だよ
とにかくよろしくね…アズィーザ！
speeches.English:
Oh, you're exaggerating! We've 
 helped each other. Anyway, 
 welcome aboard... Aziza!

SC0 B187.summary: The former crew confronts Aziza again. The labels distinguish who threatens the party and who reacts when the threat turns against them.

speeches.Japanese: げ！　あ、あの女は！
speeches.English: Oh, no. It's her!

speeches.Japanese: たしかアズィーザ・ヌレンナハール…
speeches.English: That's Aziza Nurennahar, isn't it?

speeches.Japanese:
あんた
FOの…
珍しいとこで会うじゃないか
speeches.English:
You're with FO, aren't you?
 Fancy meeting you here.

speeches.Japanese:
ま、マズイぜ！
FI！
こいつらみんな、この女の手下だぜ！
speeches.English:
We're in trouble, FI.
 These are all her people!

speeches.Japanese:
…ふふふっ、よく見れば見るほど
かわいらしい顔をしたボウヤだね
speeches.English:
Heh. The closer I look, the cuter
 you are, boy.

speeches.Japanese:
お近づきに
アタシと一杯やるってのはどうだい？
speeches.English:
How about a drink? 
 We can get to know each other.

speeches.Japanese:
へっへっ、飛んで火に入る何とかって
ヤツか？
囲んじまえ！
speeches.English:
Heh. What's the saying? Like moths 
 to a flame? Surround 'em!

speeches.Japanese:
（どうしよう。こんなに多くの
　海賊を相手にクラウと２人で
　戦うなんて…。）
speeches.English:
(What do we do? It's just me 
 and Clau against all 
 these pirates.)

speeches.Japanese: くっ…、ど…どうする気だ！
speeches.English: Wh-what are you planning?

speeches.Japanese:
おやおや、すっかりビビっちまってる
ようだぜ。この前はずいぶんと痛い目に
遭わせてくれたじゃねえか！
speeches.English:
Well, well. Look who's scared
 stiff. You gave us quite a beating 
 last time, didn't you?

speeches.Japanese:
…待ちな！
今はアタシがこのボウヤと話してるんだ
おまえたちはすっこんでな！
speeches.English:
Hold it! I'm talking to the boy. 
 Stay out of it!

speeches.Japanese: うひっ、すいやせん
speeches.English: Eep! Sorry!

speeches.Japanese:
あんたらとの決着はまだついて
いないんだ。こんなとこで死なれちゃ
つまらないからね
speeches.English:
We've still got a score to settle. 
 It'd be a shame if you died
 in a place like this.

speeches.Japanese: げっ、なんなんだ、この女！？
speeches.English: What is with this woman?!

speeches.Japanese:
アタシは海賊だよ
勝負は海の上でつける！
speeches.English:
I'm a pirate.
 We'll settle this at sea!

speeches.Japanese:
…今日のところは、この人数を相手に
逃げ出さなかっただけでも褒めてやろう
じゃないか。ねえ？
speeches.English:
For today, I'll give you credit
 for standing your ground against 
 this many. How's that?

speeches.Japanese:
…僕だって提督だ
逃げ出すわけにはいかない
speeches.English:
I'm an admiral, too. I can't just
 run away.

speeches.Japanese:
なかなか言うじゃない
ホントに度胸のあるボウヤだこと
気に入ったわ
speeches.English:
That's quite an answer.
 You've got guts, boy. I like you.

speeches.Japanese: …あんたの名前は？
speeches.English: What's your name?

speeches.Japanese: FI・FA
speeches.English: FI FA

speeches.Japanese:
名前とその顔、覚えておこうじゃないの
また逢いましょう
…今度は海の上でね
speeches.English:
I'll remember your name
 and that face. We'll meet again... 
 at sea next time.

speeches.Japanese: …んっ！？　その剣は…
speeches.English: Hmm? That sword...

speeches.Japanese: え？
speeches.English: Huh?

speeches.Japanese:
…ボウヤ、いい剣を持ってるねえ
でも、アタシのほうが似合いそうだから
そのうち、いただくことにするよ
speeches.English:
That's a fine sword, boy. It'd look
 better on me, though. I'll take
 it off your hands one of these days.

speeches.Japanese: な、なんのことですか…？
speeches.English: Wh-what do you mean?

speeches.Japanese:
分からなければいいさ
さ、野郎ども！　引き上げるよっ！
speeches.English:
Never mind, then. Come on, boys! 
 We're leaving!

speeches.Japanese: オオーッ！
speeches.English: Aye!

speeches.Japanese: …すげえ。一声で仕切ってやがる…
speeches.English:
Wow. One word from her and they all
 fall in line...

speeches.Japanese: …ふう、助かった…
speeches.English: Whew. We made it...

speeches.Japanese:
今の…かなりビビったぜ
あの女、だてに海賊の頭を
やってるわけじゃねえな
speeches.English:
She had me scared stiff. No wonder 
 she's the one in charge
 of those pirates.

speeches.Japanese:
そうだね。凄い迫力だった…
でも、海の上で決着つけようなんて
海賊のプライドかな？
speeches.English:
She was something, all right. Think
 it's pirate pride that makes 
 her want to settle it at sea?

speeches.Japanese:
ああ、そんなもんだろうな。逆に言やあ
あんなのに追っかけまわされたら
たまったもんじゃねえぜ
speeches.English:
Probably. I sure wouldn't want 
 someone like her on our tail.

speeches.Japanese:
ま、今から心配したって
しょうがねえな
speeches.English: No sense worrying about it now.

speeches.Japanese: そうだね…
speeches.English: Yeah...

SC1 B3.summary: Aziza prepares for the encounter. Snake, Angel and Dandy answer her in their own voices.

speeches.Japanese:
あれを見な！
あの艦隊こそ、アタシらの縄張りを
荒らしている
FOだ！
speeches.English:
Look there! That's FO,
 the fleet that's been muscling 
 in on our waters!

speeches.Japanese: オオーッ！
speeches.English: Aye!

speeches.Japanese:
総員戦闘配備！
スネーク、指揮を執って！
speeches.English:
All hands, battle stations! Snake, 
 take command!

speeches.Japanese: おうよ
speeches.English: Aye.

speeches.Japanese:
エンジェル！
船を敵の右後方へ！
speeches.English:
Angel! Bring us around 
 to their right rear!

speeches.Japanese:
おっしゃっっっ！
がってん承知だぜい！！！
speeches.English: You got it! Leave it to me!

speeches.Japanese:
ダンディー！　
砲撃の準備は？
speeches.English: Dandy! Are the guns ready?

speeches.Japanese: 整っております
speeches.English: Ready.

speeches.Japanese:
…ふふっ、ゾクゾクするわ
いいかい、野郎どもっ！！！
speeches.English:
Heh... what a thrill. Listen up, 
 you dogs!

speeches.Japanese:
今こそアタシと
FO、どちらが
この海を支配するにふさわしいか
決めてやろうじゃないか！
speeches.English:
Let's settle who deserves
 to rule these waters:
 me or FO!

speeches.Japanese: オオーッ！！！
speeches.English: Aye!!!

speeches.Japanese: …海賊か
speeches.English: Pirates.

speeches.Japanese: リーダーは女のようですが…
speeches.English: It seems a woman leads them...

speeches.Japanese:
女だろうと
海賊であることに変わりはない
戦闘準備に入れ
speeches.English:
Woman or not, she's a pirate.
 Prepare for battle.

speeches.Japanese: 分かりました
speeches.English: Understood.

SC1 B17.summary: Aziza’s crew turns on her after a defeat, blaming the losses and her pursuit of the fleet that has her father’s sword. Al intervenes. The confrontation leads to a settlement and Aziza explains what the sword means to her.

speeches.Japanese:
くっ、また負けたか…
だが、今度こそ………はっ！
speeches.English:
Damn, beaten again... But next 
 time... Huh?!

speeches.Japanese:
悪いが
あんたにゃ『今度』はねえんだ
speeches.English:
Sorry, but you ain't getting 
 a next time.

speeches.Japanese: くっくっくっ
speeches.English: Heh heh...

speeches.Japanese: なんだって！？　もう一度言ってみな！
speeches.English: What?! Say that again!

speeches.Japanese: ああ？　聞こえなかったか？
speeches.English: Huh? Didn't hear me?

speeches.Japanese:
あんたの言うことを聞くヤツなんざ
ここにゃ、誰もいねえってことよ！
speeches.English:
Nobody here obeys you anymore. 
 Not one of us!

speeches.Japanese:
…ちきしょう！
てめえら、裏切ったね！！
speeches.English: Damn you! You betrayed me!

speeches.Japanese: 向こうが騒がしいようだが…
speeches.English: There's a commotion over there...

speeches.Japanese:
くだんの女海賊を
配下が取り囲んでおるようですぞ
speeches.English:
That pirate's own men seem 
 to have surrounded her.

speeches.Japanese: …船を近づけろ
speeches.English: ...Bring us closer.

speeches.Japanese:
ここんとこ、負け続けでちっとも金が
増えやしねえ。あんたには、その責任を
とってもらわねえと
speeches.English:
We keep losing and earn nothing. 
 Someone must answer
 for that, and it will be you.

speeches.Japanese: 責任だと…
speeches.English: Answer?!

speeches.Japanese:
だいたい
なぜFOを
追いかけ回すんですかい？
speeches.English:
Why keep chasing 
 FO, anyway?

speeches.Japanese:
へっ、みんなに言えない
理由があるんだろ？！
speeches.English:
Heh. Hiding the reason from us,
 are you?!

speeches.Japanese:
あんたの魂胆は
FOから
『血塗られたシャムシール』を
取り戻したいだけなんだ
親父の形見だもんな！
speeches.English:
All you want is to get 
 the Bloodstained Shamshir back 
 from FO. Your old 
 man's keepsake, ain't it?

speeches.Japanese: それは…そんなつもりじゃ…
speeches.English: That's... That wasn't what I...

speeches.Japanese:
最近のあんたは、なってなかったぜ
金も稼げねえ頭についていく物好きは
いねえよ。覚悟しな！
speeches.English:
You've been slipping lately. No
 one's following a leader who can't 
 make us any money. Get ready!

speeches.Japanese:
提督！
このまま放っておけば
あの女、殺されますぞ！
speeches.English:
Admiral! They will kill
 her if we do nothing!

speeches.Japanese: …見捨てるわけにもいくまい
speeches.English: We cannot abandon her.

speeches.Japanese: じゃ、行くぞ
speeches.English: Then I'm going in.

speeches.Japanese: お、おい、早まるでない！
speeches.English: W-wait! Do not be rash!

speeches.Japanese:
なんだあ？
よそ者は引っ込んでな！
speeches.English: Huh? Stay out of this, outsider!

speeches.Japanese: …下っ端が図に乗るな
speeches.English: ...Don't get cocky, lackeys.

speeches.Japanese:
てめえにゃ関係ねえ！
…この際だ、アズィーザもこいつも
まとめて片付けろ！
speeches.English:
This ain't your business! ...While 
 we're at it, finish him off along
 with Aziza!

speeches.Japanese: アル殿、助太刀いたす
speeches.English: Al, my aid is yours.

speeches.Japanese:
あたしもやる！
数を頼むしかない男なんて、最低よ！
speeches.English:
Count me in! Men who have to gang
 up on someone are the worst!

speeches.Japanese:
ああいう奴らは、景気よくドカーンと
吹き飛ばしましょうか
speeches.English:
Then let us blow them away 
 with a fine, loud boom!

speeches.Japanese:
…海賊ども！
さあ来い、やってやる！
speeches.English: Pirates! Come and face me!

speeches.Japanese:
どうして…？　なんで、アタシのために
戦ってるんだよ…
さっきまで敵だったのに…
speeches.English:
Why...? Why fight for me?
 We were enemies moments ago...

speeches.Japanese: く、くそっ、これじゃ分が悪いぜ！
speeches.English: D-damn! The odds are against us!

speeches.Japanese: ようやく気づいたか
speeches.English: Finally noticed, have you?

speeches.Japanese: FI・FA…
speeches.English: FI FA...

speeches.Japanese: …あんたもこの女を助けに来たのか？
speeches.English: You came to save her too?

speeches.Japanese: そうだと言ったら？
speeches.English: And if we did?

speeches.Japanese:
ちっ、この女が全部悪いってのに
なんで俺たちがこんな目に…
speeches.English:
Tch. This is all her fault. Why
 are we the ones...?

speeches.Japanese:
…そろそろ、愚痴も言い飽きただろう
もう彼女を解放してはどうだ
speeches.English:
You have complained enough.
 Why not release her now?

speeches.Japanese:
アズィーザがいなくなれば
それでいいのだろう？
speeches.English: You only want Aziza gone, correct?

speeches.Japanese:
聞こえてたのか
もう、誰もこの女にはついていかねえ
speeches.English:
So you heard.
 Nobody follows her now.

speeches.Japanese:
ならば
アズィーザは俺たちが引き取ろう
speeches.English: Then we shall take Aziza with us.

speeches.Japanese:
そうかい
だからって、タダでくれてやるわけにゃ
いかねえな
speeches.English:
Fine.
 We ain't letting her go for free.

speeches.Japanese: 金を取るだと！？
speeches.English: Money?!

speeches.Japanese:
アル、よせ
で、いくらで手を打つ？
speeches.English: Al, enough. What is your price?
One million gold.

speeches.Japanese: アズィーザ…来い
speeches.English: Aziza... come.

speeches.Japanese: 用は済んだな。あばよ！
speeches.English: That settles it. So long!

speeches.Japanese:
まさか、仲間に裏切られるとは
アタシも落ちたもんだよ…
それより、どうしてアタシを
助けたんだ？
speeches.English:
Betrayed by my own crew... I've
 really sunk low. But why 
 did you save me?

speeches.Japanese: 放っておけなかった…
speeches.English: I couldn't leave you there...

speeches.Japanese:
あの状況で助けないというのは
よほど非人道的な輩だぞ
speeches.English: Only a brute would abandon you.

speeches.Japanese:
拙者、気になっておったのだが…
そなたほどの者、なぜ海賊などに
身を落としているのだ？
speeches.English:
Something has puzzled me... Why
 would someone of your skill stoop
 to piracy?

speeches.Japanese:
買いかぶってくれるね
…身を落としたわけじゃないよ
アタシは海賊の娘。父さんが
海賊なんだ
speeches.English:
You think too highly of me.
 ...I didn't stoop to anything. 
 I'm a pirate's daughter. My father 
 was a pirate.

speeches.Japanese: ほう
speeches.English: Oh?

speeches.Japanese:
さっきの海賊どもは、父さんの手下
子供のころから、見よう見まねで
剣術を覚え
海賊稼業を学んだのさ
speeches.English:
Those pirates were my father's men.
 I grew up learning swordplay 
 and the pirate trade by watching 
 and copying.

speeches.Japanese: 父上はどうされているのだ？
speeches.English: Where is your father?

speeches.Japanese:
事故で死んだ
…例の剣は父さんの宝物だったのさ
父さんと一緒に消えたけど…
speeches.English:
He died in an accident.
 ...That sword was his treasure.
 It disappeared with him...

speeches.Japanese:
その剣が
『血塗られたシャムシール』…
speeches.English: The Bloodstained Shamshir...

speeches.Japanese:
アタシは父さんのような偉大な海賊に
なりたかった
父さんのことはなんでもまねした…
speeches.English:
I wanted to be a great pirate, just
 like him. I copied everything
 he did...

speeches.Japanese:
だから、あんたたちがこの剣を
持ってるって知ったとき、どうしても
手に入れたくなったんだ
そうすれば…
speeches.English:
So when I found out
 you had his sword, 
 I had to have it. I thought...

speeches.Japanese:
そうすれば、父さんに近づいた証に
なるって…
ふふっ、だけどね
speeches.English:
I thought it would prove 
 I was getting closer to being
 like him. Heh... But, you know...

speeches.Japanese:
偉大な海賊になるより、ホントは
父さんの形見が欲しかっただけ
なんだって
気が付いちゃってさ…
speeches.English:
I realized I didn't really want
 to be a great pirate. I just 
 wanted something to remember 
 my father by...

speeches.Japanese:
こんなんじゃ、見捨てられて当然ね
金にならない物を追いかけてたんだから
仲間が怒るのも無理ないか
speeches.English:
No wonder they left me.
 I was chasing something
 that wouldn't earn a thing. I can't
 blame them for being angry.

speeches.Japanese: …まだ海賊に未練があるのか
speeches.English: ...Do you still want to be a pirate?

speeches.Japanese:
アタシが追っていたのは海賊じゃ
なくて、父さんだったんだもの
もう、足を洗うつもりさ
speeches.English:
It wasn't piracy I was chasing.
 It was my father. I'm leaving
 that life behind.

speeches.Japanese: 提督…
speeches.English: Sir...

speeches.Japanese:
アル、言いたいことは分かっている
アズィーザ、俺の船に乗るか？
speeches.English:
Al, I know what you're going 
 to say. Aziza, 
 will you sail with us?

speeches.Japanese:
ありがたいね…
…アタシ、ガンガン働くよ
なんたってアンタは命の恩人だからね
speeches.English:
I'd be grateful... I'll work 
 my heart out. After all, I owe 
 you my life.

speeches.Japanese:
それから、アタシのことは
アズィーザでいいわ
speeches.English: And from now on, just call me Aziza.

speeches.Japanese:
恩人に忠義を尽くすのも
ひとつの生き方でござる
speeches.English: Serving a savior is a worthy path.

speeches.Japanese: また賑やかになる…
speeches.English:
Things are going to get
 even livelier...

SC1 B179.summary: The former crew confronts Aziza again. The labels distinguish who threatens the party and who reacts when the threat turns against them.

speeches.Japanese: む…あの女…
speeches.English: Her...?

speeches.Japanese:
あんた
FOの…
こんなところで会うとは
思わなかったねえ
speeches.English:
You... from FO. Never 
 expected to meet here.

speeches.Japanese: なぜ我々の艦隊をつけまわす！？
speeches.English: Why stalk our fleet?!

speeches.Japanese:
あ～ら
いきなりそんな話を切り出すなんて
野暮なおじさまねえ
speeches.English:
My, my. Straight to business? What 
 a tiresome man you are.

speeches.Japanese:
せっかく楽しいひとときを
一緒に過ごそうと思ったのに
speeches.English:
And here I thought we might enjoy
 a little time together.

speeches.Japanese: …なんだ、この女は！
speeches.English: ...What is wrong with this woman?!

speeches.Japanese:
くっくっく。いかにも堅苦しい軍人
だものね
冗談も通じやしないよ
speeches.English:
Hehehe. Stiff as a board, just like
 a proper military man. Can't even
 take a joke.

speeches.Japanese:
…さては、ここで我々を待ち伏せし
我らの暗殺を企んだか！
speeches.English:
So you were lying in wait here 
 to assassinate us?!

speeches.Japanese:
へっ、人数考えな
あんたらは２人
こっちは数十人だぜ！
speeches.English:
Count them!
 Two of you, dozens of us!

speeches.Japanese: 卑怯な…
speeches.English: Coward

speeches.Japanese:
…エンジェル
アンタいつからそんな偉く
なったんだい？
speeches.English:
...Angel.
 Since when did you get so important?

speeches.Japanese: うっ、い、いや…、オレは…
speeches.English: Uh! N-no, I...

speeches.Japanese:
よけいな口挟むんじゃないよ
引っ込んでな！
speeches.English:
Keep your mouth shut and get 
 back there!

speeches.Japanese: へ、へい！
speeches.English: Y-yes!

speeches.Japanese:
ふんっ
…勘違いされちゃ困るわ
speeches.English: Hmph. Don't misunderstand.

speeches.Japanese:
ここであんたらを殺すなんざ
アタシのプライドが許さないね！
speeches.English:
My pride wouldn't let me kill
 you here!

speeches.Japanese: ほう。海賊にもプライドがあるのか
speeches.English: Pirates have pride?

speeches.Japanese:
海賊には海賊の誇りってもんがある
あんたも海の男なら分かるだろう
決着は海の上でつけてやるよ！
speeches.English:
Pirates have their own honor.
 As a seaman, you know. 
 Our reckoning comes at sea!

speeches.Japanese: そのときは受けて立とう
speeches.English: Challenge accepted.

speeches.Japanese:
分かったら、首を洗って待ってな！
…はっ！
speeches.English:
Then you'd better be ready 
 to die! ...Oh!

speeches.Japanese: どうかしたか？
speeches.English: What now?

speeches.Japanese: …いい剣を持ってるね
speeches.English: A fine sword.

speeches.Japanese:
そうかい、あんたが持ってたとは…
ふふふ…
いずれアタシのものにしてやるよ
speeches.English:
So you had it... Heh. Someday
 that sword will be mine.

speeches.Japanese: 何を言っているのかまるで分からんぞ
speeches.English: Your meaning escapes me.

speeches.Japanese:
いずれ、分かる日が来るよ
さ、野郎ども、引き上げだっ！
speeches.English: Someday you'll know. Men, withdraw!

speeches.Japanese: オオーッ！
speeches.English: Aye!

speeches.Japanese:
変な女だ…
だが、統率力は誉めてやってもいい
speeches.English:
A strange woman... But I will give 
 her credit for her leadership.

speeches.Japanese:
艦隊の１つや２つ
たやすく指揮できるに違い
ありませんな
speeches.English:
She could easily command 
 a fleet or two.

speeches.Japanese: 海賊の誇り、か…
speeches.English: Pirate pride...

あの艦隊こそ、アタシらの縄張りを
荒らしている
FOだ！
speeches.English:
Look there! That's FO,
 the fleet that's been trespassing

speeches.Japanese: オオーッ！
speeches.English: Aye!

speeches.Japanese:

スネーク、指揮を執って！
speeches.English:
All hands, battle stations! Snake, 
 take command!

speeches.Japanese: おうよ
speeches.English: You got it.

speeches.Japanese:
エンジェル！
船を敵の右後方へ！
speeches.English:
Angel! Bring us around 
 to the enemy's starboard quarter!

speeches.Japanese:
おっしゃっっっ！
がってん承知だぜい！！！
speeches.English: All right! You got it!

speeches.Japanese:
ダンディー！　
砲撃の準備は？
speeches.English: Dandy! Guns ready?

speeches.Japanese: 整っております
speeches.English: Everything is ready.

speeches.Japanese:
…ふふっ、ゾクゾクするわ
いいかい、野郎どもっ！！！
speeches.English:
Heh... This gets my blood pumping. 
 Listen up, you lot!

speeches.Japanese:
今こそアタシと
FO、どちらが
この海を支配するにふさわしいか
決めてやろうじゃないか！
speeches.English:
Let's settle which of us deserves
 to rule these waters:
 me or FO!

speeches.Japanese: オオーッ！！！
speeches.English: Aye!!!

speeches.Japanese: 女海賊だと！？
speeches.English: A woman pirate?!

speeches.Japanese:
へえ、おもしろいじゃない
やってやるわ！
speeches.English:
Oh, this should be interesting.
 I'll take her on!

speeches.Japanese: みんな！　戦闘よ！
speeches.English: Everyone! Battle stations!

speeches.Japanese:

だが、今度こそ………はっ！
speeches.English:
Damn, beaten again...
 But next time... Huh?!

speeches.Japanese:
悪いが
あんたにゃ『今度』はねえんだ
speeches.English:
Sorry, but there won't be
 a next time for you.

speeches.Japanese: くっくっくっ
speeches.English: Heh heh...

speeches.Japanese: なんだって！？　もう一度言ってみな！
speeches.English: What?! Say that again!

speeches.Japanese: ああ？　聞こえなかったか？
speeches.English: Huh? Didn't you hear me?

speeches.Japanese:
あんたの言うことを聞くヤツなんざ
ここにゃ、誰もいねえってことよ！
speeches.English:
Nobody here obeys you anymore. 
 Not one of us!

speeches.Japanese:
…ちきしょう！
てめえら、裏切ったね！！
speeches.English: Damn you! You betrayed me!

speeches.Japanese: ん？　なんかうるさいなあ
speeches.English: Huh? What's all that noise?

speeches.Japanese:
例の女海賊の船で、もめごとが
起きたみてえだな
speeches.English:
Looks like there's trouble aboard
 that woman pirate's ship.

speeches.Japanese: 何だろ？　ちょっと見てこようよ
speeches.English:
What's going on? Let's go
 have a look.

speeches.Japanese:
ここんとこ、負け続けでちっとも金が
増えやしねえ。あんたには、その責任を
とってもらわねえと
speeches.English:
We've done nothing but lose lately,
 and we're not making a penny.
 You're going to answer for that.

speeches.Japanese: 責任だと…
speeches.English: Answer for it...?

speeches.Japanese:
だいたい
なぜFOを
追いかけ回すんですかい？
speeches.English: Why keep chasing FO, anyway?

speeches.Japanese:
へっ、みんなに言えない
理由があるんだろ？！
speeches.English:
Heh. You've got a reason you don't 
 want the rest of us
 to hear, don't you?

speeches.Japanese:
あんたの魂胆は
FOから
『血塗られたシャムシール』を
取り戻したいだけなんだ
親父の形見だもんな！
speeches.English:
You just want
 the Bloodstained Shamshir
 back from FO because it's 
 your father's keepsake!

speeches.Japanese: それは…そんなつもりじゃ…
speeches.English: That's... I didn't mean to...

speeches.Japanese:
最近のあんたは、なってなかったぜ
金も稼げねえ頭についていく物好きは
いねえよ。覚悟しな！
speeches.English:
You've lost your touch. Nobody's 
 fool enough to follow a boss who 
 can't make us money. Get ready!

speeches.Japanese:
このままじゃ
あの女海賊はやられちゃう！
どうしよう…
speeches.English:
They will kill her! What 
 should we do...?

speeches.Japanese: 俺に任せときな…
speeches.English: Leave it to me.

speeches.Japanese: アル…？

なんだあ？
よそ者は引っ込んでな！
speeches.English:
What's this? Stay out
 of it, stranger!

speeches.Japanese: …下っ端が図に乗るな
speeches.English: ...Don't get cocky, you lackeys.

speeches.Japanese:
てめえにゃ関係ねえ！
…この際だ、アズィーザもこいつも
まとめて片付けろ！
speeches.English:
This has nothing to do with you! 
 ...Never mind. Take him and Aziza
 out together!

speeches.Japanese: アル殿、助太刀いたす
speeches.English: Al, allow me to assist you.

speeches.Japanese:
あたしもやる！
数を頼むしかない男なんて、最低よ！
speeches.English:
I'm in, too! Men who need
 a whole gang to win make me sick!

speeches.Japanese:
てめえらもツイてねえぜ
俺が相手になってやろうじゃねえか！
speeches.English:
Bad luck for you! I'll 
 take you on, too!

speeches.Japanese:
…海賊ども！
さあ来い、やってやる！
speeches.English: Pirates! Come and face me!

speeches.Japanese:
どうして…？　なんで、アタシのために
戦ってるんだよ…
さっきまで敵だったのに…
speeches.English:
Why...? Why fight for me?
 We were enemies moments ago...

speeches.Japanese: く、くそっ、これじゃ分が悪いぜ！
speeches.English: D-damn it! This isn't looking good!

speeches.Japanese: さっきまでの勢いはどうしたのよ！
speeches.English: Lost your nerve already?!

speeches.Japanese: FI・FA…
speeches.English: FI FA...

speeches.Japanese: …あんたもこの女を助けに来たのか？
speeches.English: You came to save her too?

speeches.Japanese: そうよ。もういい加減にしたら？
speeches.English:
That's right. Isn't it time
 you stopped this?

speeches.Japanese:
もう、この女にはウンザリだ
だが、あんたらには関係ない
よけいな手出しはやめてくんな
speeches.English:
We are sick of her.
 But this is none of your concern.
 Stay out of it.

speeches.Japanese:
そりゃ、関係ないけど。でも
人が殺されるのを放っておく
わけにもいかないでしょ
speeches.English:
Maybe it doesn't. But I can't
 just stand here and let
 you kill someone!

speeches.Japanese: …その女に手を出すな
speeches.English: ...Don't lay a hand on her.

speeches.Japanese:
…そんなに、アズィーザが大事なら
金で解決してやってもいいぜ
speeches.English:
...If Aziza matters that much
 to you, we could settle
 this for a price.

speeches.Japanese: いくら？
speeches.English: How much?

speeches.Japanese:
FI！
こんな奴らにお金を払うつもり！？
speeches.English:
FI! You're going to pay 
 these thugs?!

speeches.Japanese: お金なら、また稼げばいいよ。ね？
speeches.English:
We can always earn more
 money. Right?

speeches.Japanese: そんな、アタシのために…
speeches.English: All this... for me?

speeches.Japanese: じゃあ金２００００００で手を打とう
speeches.English:
Then let's settle on 
 two million coins.
One million.

speeches.Japanese:
うっ、ま、まあそれでいいか
金１００００００と交換だ
speeches.English: W-well, agreed. One million for her.

speeches.Japanese:
分かったわ
じゃあ、アズィーザさんはこっちに来て
speeches.English: Agreed. Aziza, come with us.

speeches.Japanese: FI…
speeches.English: FI...

speeches.Japanese: もう用はねえ。あばよ！
speeches.English: We're done here. So long!

speeches.Japanese:
まさか、仲間に裏切られるとは
アタシも落ちたもんだよ…
それより、どうしてアタシを助けたんだ？
speeches.English:
Betrayed by my own crew... I've
 really fallen low. But why 
 did you save me?

speeches.Japanese: …しょうがないだろう
speeches.English: ...What else could we do?

speeches.Japanese:
まあ、成り行きもあるし、バスラの
酒場であたしたちを見逃してくれた
でしょ？　普通の海賊じゃないなって
気がしたのよね
speeches.English:
Well, one thing led to another.
 And you let us go at that tavern 
 in Basra, remember?
 I thought you might be more
 than an ordinary pirate.

speeches.Japanese:
なあ、なんで海賊なんかやってんだ？
あんたの腕なら、まっとうな仕事で
十分稼げるぜ
speeches.English:
Why be a pirate, anyway? 
 With your skills, you could make 
 plenty doing honest work.

speeches.Japanese:
…アタシは、子供のころから
見よう見まねで剣術を覚え
海賊稼業を学んだんだ
speeches.English:
...I grew up learning swordplay
 and piracy by watching and copying.

speeches.Japanese: え？
speeches.English: You did?

speeches.Japanese:
…父さんが海賊だったのさ
他の稼業なんて考えたこともなかったよ
さっきの海賊どもは、父さんの手下
speeches.English:
My father was a pirate. No other 
 life ever occurred to me. Those men
 served under him.

speeches.Japanese: 親父さんはどこにいる？
speeches.English: Where's your father now?

speeches.Japanese:
事故で死んだ
…例の剣は父さんの宝物だったんだよ
父さんと一緒に消えたけど…
speeches.English:
He died in an accident.
 ...That sword was his treasure.
 It vanished with him...

speeches.Japanese:
その剣が
『血塗られたシャムシール』…
speeches.English: The Bloodstained Shamshir...

speeches.Japanese:
『いい剣を持ってる』って言ったのは
その剣のことだったんだ…
speeches.English:
So that's what you meant when
 you said we had a fine sword...

speeches.Japanese:
アタシは父さんのような偉大な海賊に
なりたかった
父さんのことはなんでもまねした…
speeches.English:
I wanted to be a great pirate like 
 my father. I copied everything 
 he did...

speeches.Japanese:
だから、あんたたちがこの剣を
持ってるって知ったとき
どうしても手に入れたくなったんだ
そうすれば…
speeches.English:
When I heard you had the sword,
 I had to have it.
 I thought if I got it back...

speeches.Japanese:
そうすれば、父さんに近づいた証に
なるって…
ふふっ、だけどね
speeches.English:
...it'd prove I was more like him. 
 Heh. But you know...

speeches.Japanese:
偉大な海賊になるより、ホントは
父さんの形見が欲しかっただけ
なんだって
気が付いちゃってさ…
speeches.English:
I've realized that becoming a great
 pirate wasn't really what I wanted.
 I just wanted something to remember
 my father by...

speeches.Japanese:
こんなんじゃ、見捨てられて当然ね
金にならない物を追いかけてたんだから
仲間が怒るのも無理ないか
speeches.English:
No wonder they abandoned me. I was 
 chasing something that wouldn't
 make us any money. I suppose 
 I can't blame them for being angry.

speeches.Japanese: …まだ海賊に未練があるのか
speeches.English: ...Do you still want to be a pirate?

speeches.Japanese:
アタシが追っていたのは海賊じゃ
なくて、父さんだったんだもの
もう、足を洗うつもりさ
speeches.English:
It was my father I was chasing,
 not piracy. I'm going to leave 
 that life behind.

speeches.Japanese:
じゃあ、あたしたちと一緒に行こうよ
せっかくのその腕
もったいないじゃない？
speeches.English:
Then come with us! Skill like yours
 should not go to waste.

speeches.Japanese:
アタシがアンタらと…？
いいのかい…？
speeches.English: Me, with you...? Are you sure...?

speeches.Japanese: もちろん！　強い人は歓迎よ
speeches.English:
Of course! We can always use 
 someone strong!

speeches.Japanese:
ありがと…
目一杯、働かせてもらうよ
なんたって命の恩人だものね
speeches.English:
Thank you... I'll work as hard 
 as I can. You saved my life, 
 after all.

speeches.Japanese:
それから、アタシのことは
アズィーザでいいわ
speeches.English: And from now on, just call me Aziza.

speeches.Japanese:
よーし！
みんな、今の話、聞いたわよね！
アズィーザ
ビシバシ働いてもらうわよ！
speeches.English:
All right! Everyone heard
 that, didn't they? I'm going to put
 you to work, Aziza!

SC2 B175.summary: The former crew confronts Aziza again. The labels distinguish who threatens the party and who reacts when the threat turns against them.

speeches.Japanese: あれ？　あの人なんか見覚えある…
speeches.English:
Huh? I feel like I've seen 
 her somewhere...

speeches.Japanese: どれどれ…？
speeches.English: Let's see...

speeches.Japanese: おっと。あんたはこの前の…
speeches.English: Well, you're the one from...

speeches.Japanese:
あんた！
あ、あのときの女海賊！
speeches.English:
You! Y-You're that pirate woman
 from before!

speeches.Japanese:
まさか、こんなところで
会うとはねえ
speeches.English: Never thought we'd meet here.

speeches.Japanese:
お嬢ちゃんたち、いい度胸じゃねえか
こんなところに２人きりで来て
無傷で帰れるつもりかい？
speeches.English:
You two have some nerve, coming
 here alone. Think you'll leave 
 in one piece?

speeches.Japanese:
やばい…いつのまにか囲まれてるよ
FI
どうしよう…
speeches.English:
We're in trouble...
 When did they surround us? FI,
 what do we do?

speeches.Japanese:
ちょっと！　これがあんたの手なの？
大人数で囲むなんて
ずいぶん卑怯じゃないのよ！
speeches.English:
So this is your trick? Surrounding 
 us with a gang? That's cowardly!

speeches.Japanese: なんだと！　このガキ！
speeches.English: What was that, brat?!

speeches.Japanese:
FIってば…
こんなところでケンカを売って
どうするつもりなのさ
speeches.English: FI, why pick a fight here?

speeches.Japanese:
へっへっへ
観念しな
speeches.English: Heh! Give up.

speeches.Japanese: よしな！
speeches.English: Enough!

speeches.Japanese: いいんですかい？
speeches.English: Are you sure?

speeches.Japanese:
何度も言ってるだろ
アタシらはチンピラじゃないんだ
海賊としての誇りがあるだろ！
speeches.English:
How many times do I have to tell 
 you? We're pirates, not common 
 thugs! Have some pride!

speeches.Japanese: （…へえ、そういう人なんだ…。）
speeches.English: (Huh... So that's what she's like.)

speeches.Japanese:
別に、ここであんたを殺すつもりは
ないさ。海賊は海賊らしく、海の上で
決着をつける。だが
その時は逃げるんじゃないよ！
speeches.English:
I'm not planning to kill you here. 
 Pirates settle things at sea.
 But when the time comes, 
 don't you run!

speeches.Japanese:
逃げないわよ！
あったりまえでしょ！
speeches.English: Run? Never!

speeches.Japanese:
ふふん、言うじゃないか
その度胸は気に入ったよ
あんたの名前は？
speeches.English:
Heh. I like your nerve.
 What's your name?

speeches.Japanese: FI・FAよ！
speeches.English: FI FA!

speeches.Japanese:
ずいぶんかわいい提督さんも
いたもんだね
…ん！？
speeches.English: Such a cute little admiral... Hm?!

speeches.Japanese:
なによ！
まだ何か文句があるの？
speeches.English: What now? Another complaint?

speeches.Japanese:
…お嬢ちゃん。いい剣を持ってるねえ
あんたには釣り合わないみたいだから
そのうち、アタシがいただくよ
speeches.English:
You've got a fine sword
 there, girl. Seems wasted on you.
 One of these days, I'll take 
 it for myself.

speeches.Japanese: 何のこと？
speeches.English: What are you talking about?

speeches.Japanese:
分からなきゃいいさ
さ、野郎ども！　引き上げだっ！
speeches.English:
Never mind, then. Come on, men!
 We're leaving!

speeches.Japanese: オオーッ！
speeches.English: Aye!

speeches.Japanese:
助かったか…
今度ばかりはダメかと思ったよ
speeches.English:
Whew... I really thought 
 we were done for this time.

speeches.Japanese:
あーいうのは
強気に出たほうがいいのよ！
speeches.English:
With people like that, you've got
 to act tough!

speeches.Japanese:
あの人、凄い迫力だったね
FIも怖いけど
それ以上っていうか…
speeches.English:
She was really intimidating. 
 You're scary too, FI, 
 but she's even scarier...

speeches.Japanese:
何よそれ、一言多くない？
でも、海の上で決着つけようなんて
結構カッコイイじゃん
speeches.English:
Hey, watch it! But settling things 
 at sea... That's pretty cool.

speeches.Japanese:
カッコイイって…のんきだなあ
これからあの海賊に、ずーっと
追い回されるってことなんだよ
speeches.English:
Cool? You're taking this awfully 
 lightly. That pirate's 
 going to keep chasing us 
 from now on!

speeches.Japanese:
…なんとかなるわよ！
負けやしないんだから！
speeches.English: We'll manage! I'm not going to lose!

speeches.Japanese: ホントに、負けん気は強いんだから…
speeches.English: You really do hate to lose...

SC3 B5.summary: Aziza prepares for the encounter. Snake, Angel and Dandy answer her in their own voices.

speeches.Japanese:
あれを見な！
あの艦隊こそ、アタシらの縄張りを
荒らしている
FOだ！
speeches.English:
Look there! That's FO,
 the fleet muscling in
 on our waters!

speeches.Japanese: オオーッ！
speeches.English: Yeah!

speeches.Japanese:
総員戦闘配備！
スネーク、指揮を執って！
speeches.English:
All hands, battle stations! Snake, 
 take command!

speeches.Japanese: おうよ
speeches.English: Aye.

speeches.Japanese:
エンジェル！
船を敵の右後方へ！
speeches.English:
Angel! Bring us around 
 to their right rear!

speeches.Japanese:
おっしゃっっっ！
がってん承知だぜい！！！
speeches.English: You got it! Leave it to me!

speeches.Japanese:
ダンディー！　
砲撃の準備は？
speeches.English: Dandy! Are the guns ready?

speeches.Japanese: 整っております
speeches.English: All preparations are complete.

speeches.Japanese:
…ふふっ、ゾクゾクするわ
いいかい、野郎どもっ！！！
speeches.English:
Heh... what a thrill. Listen up, 
 you dogs!

speeches.Japanese:
今こそアタシと
FO、どちらが
この海を支配するにふさわしいか
決めてやろうじゃないか！
speeches.English:
It's time to settle who deserves 
 to rule these waters.
 Me, or FO!

speeches.Japanese: オオーッ！！！
speeches.English: Yeah!

speeches.Japanese: 聞いたことのない海賊ね
speeches.English: I've never heard of this pirate.

speeches.Japanese:
女の海賊とは珍しい
何か理由でもあるのかのう？
speeches.English:
A woman pirate is a rare sight.
 I wonder what led her to it.

speeches.Japanese:
理由はどうあれ
海を荒らす海賊を放置できないわ
みんな、戦闘準備よ！
speeches.English:
Whatever her reasons, we can't let 
 pirates run wild. Everyone,
 prepare for battle!

SC3 B19.summary: Aziza’s crew turns on her after a defeat, blaming the losses and her pursuit of the fleet that has her father’s sword. Al intervenes. The confrontation leads to a settlement and Aziza explains what the sword means to her.

speeches.Japanese:
くっ、また負けたか…
だが、今度こそ………はっ！
speeches.English:
Damn, beaten again...
 But next time... Huh?!

speeches.Japanese:
悪いが
あんたにゃ『今度』はねえんだ
speeches.English: Bad news. No next time for you.

speeches.Japanese: くっくっくっ
speeches.English: Heh heh...

speeches.Japanese: なんだって！？　もう一度言ってみな！
speeches.English: What?! Say that again!

speeches.Japanese: ああ？　聞こえなかったか？
speeches.English: What, didn't you hear me?

speeches.Japanese:
あんたの言うことを聞くヤツなんざ
ここにゃ、誰もいねえってことよ！
speeches.English: No one here obeys you anymore!

speeches.Japanese:
…ちきしょう！
てめえら、裏切ったね！！
speeches.English: Damn you! You traitors!

speeches.Japanese: 向こうの船で何か起きているようね
speeches.English:
Something seems to be happening
 aboard that ship.

speeches.Japanese:
ただならぬ気配じゃな
もめごとのようじゃぞ
speeches.English:
Trouble is brewing.
 A quarrel, maybe.

speeches.Japanese: 行きましょう。船を寄せてちょうだい
speeches.English:
Let's go.
 Bring us alongside, please.

speeches.Japanese:
ここんとこ、負け続けでちっとも金が
増えやしねえ。あんたには、その責任を
とってもらわねえと
speeches.English:
We keep losing, and we're
 not making any money.
 You're going to answer for that.

speeches.Japanese: 責任だと…
speeches.English: My fault?

speeches.Japanese:
だいたい
なぜFOを
追いかけ回すんですかい？
speeches.English:
And why do you keep chasing
 FO around?

speeches.Japanese:
へっ、みんなに言えない
理由があるんだろ？！
speeches.English:
Hah! You've got a reason you can't 
 tell the rest of us, don't you?

speeches.Japanese:
あんたの魂胆は
FOから
『血塗られたシャムシール』を
取り戻したいだけなんだ
親父の形見だもんな！
speeches.English:
All you want is to get 
 the Bloodstained Shamshir
 back from FO. A keepsake
 of your old man, isn't it?

speeches.Japanese: それは…そんなつもりじゃ…
speeches.English: That is... not why...

speeches.Japanese:
最近のあんたは、なってなかったぜ
金も稼げねえ頭についていく物好きは
いねえよ。覚悟しな！
speeches.English:
You've been slipping lately. 
 Nobody's fool enough to follow 
 a boss who can't make money. 
 Get ready!

speeches.Japanese:
…このままでは
彼女の命が危ないわ
speeches.English: Her life is in danger.

speeches.Japanese:
だが、第三者が口を挟むような
問題ではないじゃろうが…
speeches.English:
But this is no affair
 for outsiders...

speeches.Japanese: …俺が行く
speeches.English: ...I'll go.

speeches.Japanese: アル！
speeches.English: Al!

speeches.Japanese:
なんだあ？
よそ者は引っ込んでな！
speeches.English:
What's this? 
 Stay out of it, outsider!

speeches.Japanese: …下っ端が図に乗るな
speeches.English: ...Watch your place, lackeys.

speeches.Japanese:
てめえにゃ関係ねえ！
…この際だ、アズィーザもこいつも
まとめて片付けろ！
speeches.English:
It's none of your business!
 ...While we're at it, finish off 
 both him and Aziza!

speeches.Japanese: アル殿、助太刀いたす
speeches.English: Al, I will fight at your side.

speeches.Japanese:
あたしもやる！
数を頼むしかない男なんて、最低よ！
speeches.English:
I'm in too! Men who can only fight 
 when they outnumber someone
 are the worst!

speeches.Japanese:
ヤホゥ！
俺様が相手になってやるぜ！
speeches.English: Yahoo! Come fight me!

speeches.Japanese:
…海賊ども！
さあ来い、やってやる！
speeches.English: ...Pirates! Come on, then!

speeches.Japanese:
どうして…？　なんで、アタシのために
戦ってるんだよ…
さっきまで敵だったのに…
speeches.English:
Why...? Why fight for me?
 We were enemies only moments ago...

speeches.Japanese:
く、くそっ、分が悪いぜ！
なんでこいつら、こんなに
アズィーザに肩入れしやがるんだ…？
speeches.English:
D-damn it, this looks bad! Why 
 are they going so far
 to help Aziza...?

speeches.Japanese: 待ちなさい！
speeches.English: Wait!

speeches.Japanese: …あんたもこの女を助けに来たのか？
speeches.English: You came to save her too?

speeches.Japanese:
そのとおり
彼女に手出しするつもりなら
あなた方の身の保証はしないわ
speeches.English:
That's right. Lay a hand on her, 
 and I can't promise your safety.

speeches.Japanese: FI・FA…
speeches.English: FI FA...

speeches.Japanese: …逃げられそうにねえな
speeches.English: ...No way out, then.

speeches.Japanese:
素直に彼女を解放するなら
多少のお金を出してもいいけど
speeches.English:
If you'll release her without
 a fuss, I'm willing to pay 
 you something.

speeches.Japanese:
金１００００００出せと言ったら？
この女には、そのくらい恨みがあるんだ
speeches.English:
What if we demand 1,000,000? 
 We hate this woman that much.

speeches.Japanese: …ふざけんな！
speeches.English: ...Don't be ridiculous!

speeches.Japanese:
アル、放っておきなさい
アズィーザの身の安全が第一よ
speeches.English:
Al, stand down. Aziza's safety 
 comes first.

speeches.Japanese: アタシのために、そんな大金を…
speeches.English: All that money... for me...

speeches.Japanese:
これで文句はないわね
アズィーザさん、こっちへ
speeches.English: Satisfied? Aziza, come over here.

speeches.Japanese: 用は済んだな。あばよ！
speeches.English: We're done here. So long!

speeches.Japanese:
まさか、仲間に裏切られるとは
アタシも落ちたもんだよ…
それより、どうしてアタシを助けたの？
speeches.English:
Betrayed by my own crew... 
 How low have I sunk? 
 But why did you save me?

speeches.Japanese:
あの酒場でのこと、覚えているわ
あのときから、あなたに興味を持ったの
speeches.English:
I remember what happened 
 at that tavern. You've intrigued me
 ever since.

speeches.Japanese:
拙者、気になっておったのだが…
そなたほどの者、なぜ海賊などに
身を落としているのだ？
speeches.English:
Something has troubled me... Why 
 would one of your caliber stoop
 to piracy?

speeches.Japanese:
買いかぶってくれるね
…身を落としたわけじゃないよ
アタシは海賊の娘。父さんが海賊なんだ
speeches.English:
You give me too much credit. 
 I didn't stoop to piracy.
 I'm a pirate's daughter. 
 My father was a pirate.

speeches.Japanese: ほう
speeches.English: Oh?

speeches.Japanese:
さっきの海賊どもは、父さんの手下
子供のころから、見よう見まねで
剣術を覚え
海賊稼業を学んだのさ
speeches.English:
Those pirates were my father's men.
 As a child, I learned swordsmanship
 and the pirate trade by watching 
 and copying.

speeches.Japanese: 今は、お父様は…？
speeches.English: Your father...?

speeches.Japanese:
事故で死んだ
…例の剣は父さんの宝物だったんだよ
父さんと一緒に消えたけど…
speeches.English:
He died in an accident.
 ...That sword was his treasure.
 It disappeared along with him...

speeches.Japanese:
その剣が
『血塗られたシャムシール』…
speeches.English: That is the Bloodstained Shamshir...

speeches.Japanese:
アタシは父さんのような偉大な海賊に
なりたかった
父さんのことはなんでもまねした…
speeches.English:
I wanted to be a great pirate
 like my father. I copied 
 everything he did...

speeches.Japanese:
だから、あんたたちがこの剣を
持ってるって知ったとき
どうしても手に入れたくなったんだ
そうすれば…
speeches.English:
So when I heard you had that sword,
 I had to get it back. If I could...

speeches.Japanese: そうすれば…？
speeches.English: If you could...?

speeches.Japanese:
そうすれば、父さんに近づいた証に
なるって…
ふふっ、だけどね
speeches.English:
I thought it would prove 
 I was getting closer to being
 like him... Heh. But now...

speeches.Japanese:
偉大な海賊になるより、ホントは
父さんの形見が欲しかっただけ
なんだって
気が付いちゃってさ…
speeches.English:
I've realized that, more than
 becoming a great pirate, 
 I really just wanted something 
 to remember my father by...

speeches.Japanese:
こんなんじゃ、見捨てられて当然ね
金にならない物を追いかけてたんだから
仲間が怒るのも無理ないか
speeches.English:
No wonder they abandoned me. 
 I was chasing something
 that wouldn't make us any money. 
 I can't blame them for being angry.

speeches.Japanese: …まだ海賊に未練があるのか
speeches.English: Still drawn to piracy?

speeches.Japanese:
アタシが追っていたのは海賊じゃ
なくて、父さんだったんだもの
もう、足を洗うつもりさ
speeches.English:
It wasn't piracy I was chasing.
 It was my father. I'm leaving
 that life behind.

speeches.Japanese: 提督…
speeches.English: Admiral...

speeches.Japanese:
分かってるわ、アル。そのつもりで
助けたのよ。彼女ほどの度量を持つ人材
そういないわ
私たちと一緒に来てくれる？
speeches.English:
I know, Al. That was what
 I had in mind when I saved her.
 People of her caliber are rare.
 Will you come with us?

speeches.Japanese:
ありがと…。船に乗せてくれるんなら
あんたらのために、目一杯働くよ
なんたって命の恩人だからね
speeches.English:
Thank you... Give me a place aboard
 your ship, and I'll work as hard 
 as I can for you. You did save 
 my life, after all.

speeches.Japanese:
それから、アタシのことは
アズィーザでいいわ
speeches.English: And from now on, just call me Aziza.

speeches.Japanese:
分かったわ
今後の働きに期待してるわ
speeches.English:
Very well. I'm looking forward 
 to seeing what you can do.

SC3 B145.summary: The former crew confronts Aziza again. The labels distinguish who threatens the party and who reacts when the threat turns against them.

speeches.Japanese:
おっと。提督さんとは
縁があるみたいじゃないか
speeches.English:
Well, well. Fate keeps bringing us 
 together, Admiral.

speeches.Japanese: この前の女海賊！
speeches.English: That woman! The pirate from before!

speeches.Japanese:
FI…まずいぞ
周囲もみな海賊のようじゃぞ
speeches.English:
FI... This is bad. Everyone 
 around us looks like a pirate too.

speeches.Japanese:
お姫様にはご機嫌麗しゅう…
と言ったところかね
さて、ご注文はなにかしら？
お酒？　それとも…？
speeches.English:
Well, if it isn't Her Highness.
 What'll you have? A drink? Or...?

speeches.Japanese: へっへっへ
speeches.English: Heh heh.

speeches.Japanese: フフンッ
speeches.English: Hmph!

speeches.Japanese: …私たちをどうしようっていうの？
speeches.English: ...What do you intend?

speeches.Japanese:
へえ…、さすがだねえ
度胸がすわってるじゃないか
speeches.English: Hm... impressive. You've got nerve.

speeches.Japanese:
海賊ごときに
そんな口を利かれる筋合いはないわ！
speeches.English:
A mere pirate doesn't get to speak 
 that way!

speeches.Japanese:
…ジジイこそ、いい根性だよなあ
やろうと思えば、一瞬で八つ裂きだ
そんなこと言っていいのか？
speeches.English:
You've got nerve yourself, old man.
 We could tear you to pieces
 in an instant. You sure you want 
 to talk like that?

speeches.Japanese: やめな！
speeches.English: Enough!

speeches.Japanese: うひいっ、すいやせん
speeches.English: Eek! Sorry!

speeches.Japanese:
…あなたこそ意外に
道理をわきまえているようね
speeches.English:
...You're more reasonable
 than I expected.

speeches.Japanese:
…。ホントにたいしたお姫さんだよ
アンタ
speeches.English:
...You really
 are something, princess.

speeches.Japanese:
フンッ、このアタシをなめてもらっちゃ
困るね。アンタたちをここで殺す気は
ないよ。海賊には海賊のやり方って
もんがある
speeches.English:
Hmph! Don't underestimate me. I've 
 no intention of killing you here.
 Pirates have our own way 
 of doing things.

speeches.Japanese:
今に、海の上で決着をつけてやるよ！
首を洗って待ってな！
speeches.English:
We'll settle this at sea! Enjoy
 what time you've got left!

speeches.Japanese:
そういうこと
こちらはいつでも相手になるわ
speeches.English: I see. We're ready whenever you are.

speeches.Japanese:
そのセリフ、忘れるんじゃないよ！
…んっ！？
speeches.English: Remember those words! ...Hm?!

speeches.Japanese: どうかした？
speeches.English: What?

speeches.Japanese:
あんた、ますます気に入ったよ
いい剣を持ってるじゃないか
speeches.English:
You're growing on me. That's 
 a fine sword.

speeches.Japanese: 剣？
speeches.English: A sword?

speeches.Japanese:
分からない？　まあいいよ
だが、覚悟しときな。目を付けた物は
アタシは必ずいただくよ
speeches.English:
Don't understand? No matter. 
 Remember: what catches my eye
 always becomes mine.

speeches.Japanese: さ、野郎ども、引き上げだっ！
speeches.English: Men, we're leaving!

speeches.Japanese: オオーッ！
speeches.English: Aye!

speeches.Japanese: ほう、一声でこの人数を仕切るとは
speeches.English:
Well, well. She commands all 
 those people with a word.

speeches.Japanese:
海賊だからって甘く見たら
承知しないよ！
speeches.English: Don't dismiss me as a pirate!

speeches.Japanese: なかなかおもしろい海賊ね
speeches.English: An interesting pirate.

speeches.Japanese: 海賊のくせに気骨があるわい
speeches.English:
A pirate with some backbone, 
 at least.

speeches.Japanese:
あの調子では
当分つきまとわれそうね
speeches.English: She may hound us awhile.
